bodies: NAADAC, the Association for Addiction Professionals

exams.name: ABPP Board Certification in Addiction Psychology
exams.blurb: ABPP speciality board recognising advanced competence in assessing and treating substance use and addictive behaviour disorders.

exams.name: ABPP Board Certification in Behavioral and Cognitive Psychology
exams.blurb: Speciality board certification covering applied behaviour analysis, behaviour therapy and cognitive behavioural therapy practice.

exams.name: ABPP Board Certification in Clinical Child and Adolescent Psychology
exams.blurb: ABPP speciality board for psychologists assessing and treating children, adolescents and families across developmental and clinical contexts.

exams.name: ABPP Board Certification in Clinical Health Psychology
exams.blurb: Speciality board certification in the psychological assessment and treatment of physical illness, health behaviour and medical settings.

exams.name: ABPP Board Certification in Clinical Psychology
exams.blurb: The oldest ABPP speciality, recognising advanced competence in the assessment, diagnosis and treatment of psychological disorders.

exams.name: ABPP Board Certification in Counseling Psychology
exams.blurb: ABPP speciality board recognising competence in strengths-based counseling practice across personal, vocational and interpersonal functioning.

exams.name: ABPP Board Certification in Couple and Family Psychology
exams.blurb: Speciality board certification in systemic assessment and intervention with couples, families and larger relational systems.

exams.name: ABPP Board Certification in Forensic Psychology
exams.blurb: Speciality board for psychologists applying clinical science to legal questions, including competency, risk and civil and criminal evaluations.

exams.name: ABPP Board Certification in Geropsychology
exams.blurb: ABPP speciality board recognising advanced competence in the psychological care of older adults and their caregivers.

exams.name: ABPP Board Certification in Group Psychology
exams.blurb: Speciality board certification in group psychotherapy theory, group dynamics, leadership and the assessment of group processes.

exams.name: ABPP Board Certification in Organizational and Business Consulting Psychology
exams.blurb: Speciality board for psychologists consulting to organisations on leadership, assessment, team effectiveness and workplace change.

exams.name: ABPP Board Certification in Police and Public Safety Psychology
exams.blurb: Speciality board covering officer selection, fitness-for-duty evaluation, operational support and intervention services for public safety agencies.

exams.name: ABPP Board Certification in Psychoanalytic and Psychodynamic Psychology
exams.blurb: Speciality board recognising depth-oriented practice, with an additional subspecialty certification available in psychoanalysis.

exams.name: ABPP Board Certification in Rehabilitation Psychology
exams.blurb: Speciality board for psychologists working with disability, chronic illness and injury across rehabilitation and community settings.

exams.name: ABPP Board Certification in School Psychology
exams.blurb: Speciality board certification for psychologists delivering assessment, intervention and consultation services in educational settings.

exams.name: ABPP Board Certification in Serious Mental Illness Psychology
exams.blurb: Speciality board recognising recovery-oriented practice with people experiencing schizophrenia, bipolar disorder and other severe conditions.

exams.name: Academy of Certified Social Workers
exams.blurb: Long-standing NASW credential recognising master-level social workers with documented postgraduate supervised practice and professional references.

exams.name: Advanced Certified Hospice and Palliative Social Worker
exams.blurb: Credential for social workers in hospice and palliative care, offered at bachelor and advanced master levels with supervised practice requirements.

exams.name: Certified Advanced Social Work Case Manager
exams.blurb: NASW case management credential for master-level social workers coordinating complex health and social service plans.

exams.name: Certified Children, Youth and Family Social Worker
exams.blurb: NASW speciality credential for master-level social workers practising in child welfare, family services and youth-serving agencies.

exams.name: Certified Clinical Alcohol, Tobacco and Other Drugs Social Worker
exams.blurb: NASW speciality credential for clinically licensed social workers treating substance use disorders in health and community settings.

exams.name: Certified Social Work Case Manager
exams.blurb: NASW credential for BSW-level case managers, verifying supervised practice in assessment, service coordination and client advocacy.

exams.name: Certified Social Worker in Health Care
exams.blurb: NASW speciality credential for master-level social workers practising in hospitals, clinics and other health care settings.

exams.name: Clinical Social Worker in Gerontology
exams.blurb: NASW gerontology credential for clinically licensed social workers serving older adults, families and long-term care programmes.

exams.name: Diplomate in Clinical Social Work
exams.blurb: Advanced NASW clinical credential requiring state clinical licensure plus extensive documented postgraduate clinical social work experience.

exams.name: Qualified Clinical Social Worker
exams.blurb: NASW credential verifying clinical social work education, licensure and supervised clinical hours for practitioners in direct practice.

exams.name: IC&RC Advanced Alcohol and Drug Counselor
exams.blurb: Master-level addiction counseling credential from IC&RC, tested on clinical evaluation, treatment planning, counseling and professional ethics.

exams.name: IC&RC Alcohol and Drug Counselor
exams.blurb: Core IC&RC substance use counselor examination used by most state boards as the written test behind CADC and LADC licensure.

exams.name: IC&RC Certified Criminal Justice Addictions Professional
exams.blurb: Credential for addiction professionals working in courts, probation, jails and prisons, covering case management and offender treatment.

exams.name: IC&RC Clinical Supervisor
exams.blurb: Supervisory credential for experienced addiction counselors, examining counselor development, performance evaluation and administrative oversight.

exams.name: IC&RC Co-Occurring Disorders Professional
exams.blurb: Credential for clinicians treating combined substance use and mental health disorders, with a diplomate tier for independently licensed staff.

exams.name: IC&RC Peer Recovery
exams.blurb: Reciprocal credential for peer recovery support workers with lived experience, covering advocacy, mentoring, recovery planning and ethics.

exams.name: IC&RC Prevention Specialist
exams.blurb: Examination for substance misuse prevention professionals covering planning, education, community organisation and evaluation of prevention programmes.

exams.name: NAADAC Master Addiction Counselor
exams.body: NAADAC, the Association for Addiction Professionals
exams.blurb: Graduate-level addiction credential from the NCC AP requiring a master degree, supervised clinical hours and a national written examination.

exams.name: National Certified Addiction Counselor Level I
exams.body: NAADAC, the Association for Addiction Professionals
exams.blurb: Entry national addiction counselor credential requiring current state certification, supervised experience and a written examination.

exams.name: National Certified Addiction Counselor Level II
exams.body: NAADAC, the Association for Addiction Professionals
exams.blurb: Advanced NCC AP addiction counselor credential requiring a bachelor degree, five years of experience and a higher-level national examination.

exams.name: National Certified Adolescent Addictions Counselor
exams.body: NAADAC, the Association for Addiction Professionals
exams.blurb: NCC AP credential for counselors specialising in adolescent substance use, covering developmental issues, family systems and youth treatment models.

exams.name: National Certified Peer Recovery Support Specialist
exams.body: NAADAC, the Association for Addiction Professionals
exams.blurb: National peer recovery credential for people in sustained recovery who support others, tested on advocacy, mentoring, ethics and recovery wellness.
